title: Nonzero Euler product and all natural powers
statement: Let F be a complete normed field satisfying ‖x+y‖ ≤ max(‖x‖,‖y‖) for all x,y ∈ F, and let q ∈ F satisfy ‖q‖ < 1. The unordered product P = ∏_{d∈ℕ}(1−q^(d+1)) converges and is nonzero. For every k ∈ ℕ, the unordered product ∏_{d∈ℕ}(1−q^(d+1))^k converges, equals P^k, and is nonzero.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F], (∀ x y : F, ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖) → ∀ q : F, ‖q‖ < 1 → Multipliable (fun d : ℕ => 1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1))) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, Multipliable (fun d : ℕ => (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) = (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1))) ^ k ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) ≠ 0
